patient_id_limitation_documented: CRITICAL CLINICAL GENERALIZATION NOTE: The Masoud Nickparvar Kaggle Brain Tumor MRI dataset consists of pre-sliced 2D images (e.g., Tr-gl_0010.jpg, Te-me_0023.jpg) lacking clinical subject identifiers or DICOM metadata tags. Because slices from the same subject cannot be grouped by patient, image-level separation does NOT establish patient-level generalization. Performance on this benchmark represents slice-level categorization accuracy; perceptual hashing and near-duplicate cross-split checks are enforced to mitigate direct slice leakage.
